com.sun.tools.sjavac.comp

类 PubapiVisitor

  • java.lang.Object
    • javax.lang.model.util.AbstractElementVisitor6<R,P>
      • javax.lang.model.util.ElementScanner6<Void,Void>

  • 所有已实现的接口:
    ElementVisitor<Void,Void>

    public class PubapiVisitor
extends ElementScanner6<Void,Void>
    Utility class that constructs a textual representation of the public api of a class.

    This is NOT part of any supported API. If you write code that depends on this, you do so at your own risk. This code and its internal interfaces are subject to change or deletion without notice.
